attachment_mapping_basis: Read from what each attachment draws, not from file order. image-0 is the four-panel composition whose suptitle reads 'diverted-single-null - cells-300 - unqualified', the diverted single-null row. image-1 carries 'weak-rotation-reactor-static - cells-500 - unqualified', the limited row at requested cells -500 (553 realised cells) that the evidence page reports. image-2 is a single 1400x800 poloidal panel with two top-left series labels, the private 550-cell moment solve.

findings.disposition: folded: a follow-up section on converged-forward-solve raising the caption-band type in certificate_panel.py to the repository's 14 pt direct-label size, letting the reserved band grow to fit.
findings.summary: The three contour-level readouts are placed at fontsize 6, against a repository rule that sets tick labels, legends and direct labels at 14 pt. On the 1400x1200 attachments they render about 8 px tall, and at the roughly 900 px width the reckon column serves they fall to about 5 px, so the numbers stating the shared level arrays are readable only at full zoom. The placement repair itself works: the band sits clear of every panel and of the canvas edge. The defect is the type size the repair chose to fit the band, not the band.

findings.disposition: folded: a follow-up section on converged-forward-solve adding a boundary entry to the certificate panel's key so the cyan stroke is named, and using one hue for the reference boundary across all four panels.
findings.summary: The reference boundary is drawn cyan in the three error panels on image-0 and image-1 and is named in no legend, while the same curve is drawn blue in the flux panel where blue already means 'analytic'. A reader meeting the cyan stroke in the error panels has nothing in the figure that says what it is, and the one hue that is keyed (blue) is keyed to a different series in that panel.

findings.disposition: exempted: the canvas comes from the shared route renderer rather than from this measurement node, and re-cropping a single panel is a presentation change outside the node's write scope; the contours remain legible as delivered.
findings.summary: The single poloidal panel occupies a 302x561 px box on a 1400x800 canvas, about 15% of its area, leaving roughly 530 px of empty white to either side. The contours remain legible, but the pair of nearly coincident solved and reference contours, which is the whole content of the figure, is drawn at a fifth of the width the canvas gives it and loses the detail the comparison could have shown.

findings.disposition: folded: a follow-up section on converged-forward-solve replacing the ochre solved-flux hue in the certificate driver's painter with a clean hue that passes the repository's colour-blind separation check against the blue analytic family.
findings.summary: The solved flux family is drawn in ochre on both certificate panels, and the subtitle names it as such. The repository's plotting rules prohibit the muddy brown and ochre family for a data series, and require a clean, saturated-but-calm hue instead. Against the clean blue of the analytic family the ochre line reads as the duller of the two rather than as the series the row is reporting.
